explication: Phone Harness lets an agent run Python helpers to inspect and control a real or hosted phone. The main path is agent script → CLI runner → shared helpers → transport-selected device backend, returning screen text or action results. Android uses adb; local iPhone control uses Mirroring capture/input and Vision OCR; Cloud manages hosted sessions, with HTTPS control available for cloud iPhones. Configuration, editable agent helpers, CLI administration, updates, and telemetry support that workflow. The README documents Hermes and OpenClaw integrations; unsampled implementation details and some integration wiring are not asserted.
